-- power plant ; yeah it is difficult to have really good powerplant whitch is map friendly too
-- GC outpost - current state use much more energy than necessary; you name it UPS

Power was really holding, peak draw at 8.2GW, transition from coal to nuclear was not smoothest, but afterwards I had excess of energy. Lake was fine and I was able to squeeze ~1GW extra from pocket atom blocks.
